payload.summary: 10.66.0.10 made 24 failed SSH password attempts against jdoe on victim-web-01 in under six minutes, then logged in successfully. In the previous week jdoe had only logged in from 10.77.0.50. This is a successful password-guessing attack; treat jdoe's credentials as compromised.

attack_chain.description: 24 consecutive failed SSH passwords for jdoe from 10.66.0.10.
Successful SSH login as jdoe from 10.66.0.10 immediately after the failures, from a source jdoe had never used.

risk_factors: Successful login directly after 24 consecutive failures
Source IP never used by jdoe before the incident

proposed_actions.justification: The password was guessed and used from an unknown source. Disabling jdoe stops further access until the password is reset.
